name: printhub
description: PrintHub - Online Printing Platform (Upload -> Pay -> Print -> Collect)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../printer-service && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:setup: cd server && npx prisma db push && npx tsx src/seed.ts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,PRINTER" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:printer"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../printer-service && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
